paragraphs: By leveraging my experience in building machine learning pipelines and deploying models as FastAPI services, I can contribute to Creditspring's mission of improving financial stability and resilience for its members.
I developed and deployed scikit-learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models using TensorFlow/Keras, and integrated them into FastAPI services within Docker containers.
I have not used XGBoost yet, but I am eager to explore its capabilities in future projects.
Through my work on prototyping an agentic tool using FastMCP, Ollama gpt-oss:20b, PostgreSQL, and GitHub Actions CI, I demonstrated my ability to innovate and present solutions to stakeholders.
Could we schedule a short call to discuss how my experience aligns with Creditspring's needs and explore potential projects together?
